title: [MAIN]-The system throws the error while posting a receipt against a Subcontracting Order.
summary: Fixed subcontracting receipt posting to correctly handle multiple item variants and component lines by improving inventory matching logic and resetting the remaining quantity after successful posting.
key_points: Remaining Quantity flowfield on Delivery Challan Line now separates variants and component lines
Apply Delivery Challan shows correct remaining quantities when an item has several variants
ILE application logic matches inventory by variant and component line
RemQtytoPost is reset after the final successful consumption, so the shortage error only fires for real shortages
Receipts posted against subcontracting orders no longer fail with a false shortage error
quote: Remaining Quantity on Delivery Challan Line was aggregating inventory without enough granularity.
